policy._individuation_why: ontology/vso.ttl reads vso:Skolem as 'a particular but unnamed individual, tracked within the document by a minted handle' — which is exactly what an annotated region with an object id is. Generic would say 'a knight, not a particular knight', which is not what an annotation of one image says.
policy._countability_default_why: an annotated region is a bounded individual unless the label says otherwise; object_classes carries the Mass and Collective exceptions and the count of defaulted traits is in every lossiness report.
